tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Every panel: the tab row, the main view, every drawer tab and the pull request list. One ground, so panels read as one sheet split by lines.

tokens.name: rail
tokens.usage: The session rail on the left, top to bottom.

tokens.name: field
tokens.usage: Search fields, selects, the project picker, and a hovered or selected list row.

tokens.name: raised
tokens.usage: The composer.

tokens.name: chip
tokens.usage: Filter buttons in the rail and the user's own message bubble.

tokens.name: selected
tokens.usage: The active tab chip, a pressed icon button and the active session row.

tokens.name: selected-strong
tokens.usage: The selected file in a tree and the active segment of a segmented control.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Inset separators, the two full-height panel dividers and the separator between tab groups.

tokens.name: line-soft
tokens.usage: Separators between rows of a list: session rows, pull request rows.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings, the active tab, the selected row's text. On surface, rail, field and selected.

tokens.name: ink-body
tokens.usage: Body copy, message text, diff file names. On surface, raised and chip.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary list text: file names in a tree, select labels. On surface and field.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Toolbar labels, inactive session titles, section names. On surface, rail and field.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Ages, meta lines, placeholders and line numbers. The quietest text: at least 4.5:1 on surface, rail, field, chip and selected.

tokens.name: ink-tab
tokens.usage: An inactive tab's label and icon, on surface.

tokens.name: ink-icon
tokens.usage: Icon buttons in the tab row, on surface.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: The one solid fill: the home button and the send button.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Icon on a primary button.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Periwinkle. The active tab underline, a running session's title, the caret, the composer's focus. As text on surface and rail.

tokens.name: focus-line
tokens.usage: The composer's border, shown only while it has focus.

tokens.name: aqua
tokens.usage: Second accent: SQL and CSS file glyphs. As text or icon on surface.

tokens.name: lavender
tokens.usage: Inline code, merged pull requests, Markdown file glyphs.

tokens.name: code-bg
tokens.usage: The ground behind inline code.

tokens.name: mint
tokens.usage: Good: done, additions, passing checks, open pull requests, remote connected. Always paired with a sign or a word.

tokens.name: blue
tokens.usage: Running: the session status dot. TypeScript file glyphs.

tokens.name: amber
tokens.usage: Needs you: waiting sessions, the Board count, modified files.

tokens.name: attention-bg
tokens.usage: The Board count's ground.

tokens.name: attention-line
tokens.usage: The Board count's border.

tokens.name: red
tokens.usage: Failed sessions and deletions. Always paired with a sign or a word, since it sits close to mint in lightness.

tokens.name: add-bg
tokens.usage: An added line in a diff.

tokens.name: del-bg
tokens.usage: A removed line in a diff.

tokens.name: hunk-bg
tokens.usage: A hunk header row in a diff.

tokens.name: hunk-ink
tokens.usage: Hunk header text, on hunk-bg.

tokens.name: provider-orange
tokens.usage: The warm provider glyph in a session row.

tokens.name: provider-blue
tokens.usage: The cool provider glyph in a session row.

tokens.name: file-svelte
tokens.usage: Svelte file glyphs.

families.ui: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif
families.mono: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: title
styles.usage: The one title of a full view. Nothing in the app is larger.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: A panel's own heading: Sessions in the rail.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Separators are short, soft lines that stop before the edges.
styles.usage: Messages, tab labels, list titles. 13px is the floor for a row's name.

styles.name: tree
styles.usage: File names in the drawer's Files tree, set larger so the tree scans at a glance.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: The second line of a row: where it runs, the branch, the age.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Group labels in the rail, set in capitals.

styles.name: code-inline
styles.usage: Inline code inside body copy, on code-bg in lavender.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between icon buttons in a toolbar.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Between tabs; between a label and its count.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between filter buttons; tree row gap.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Tab row side padding; the drawer's line inset; icon-to-label gap.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Filter row bottom; group label top.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Tab horizontal padding; drawer content padding; gap in the chat column.

tokens.name: space-14
tokens.usage: The rail's side gutter and its line inset.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: The main view's side gutter and its line inset.

tokens.name: space-28
tokens.usage: The chat column's side padding; a short section rule's inset.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Filter buttons, fields, selects, segments, the Board count. Square, never a pill.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Tree rows and list rows when hovered or selected.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Tabs, icon buttons, primary buttons.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: The composer and message bubbles.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Only the Board button and a tab's close disc.

tokens.name: bar-height
tokens.usage: The tab row, and the Board row above the drawer.

tokens.name: tab-height
tokens.usage: A tab chip.

tokens.name: icon-button
tokens.usage: An icon button in the tab row.

tokens.name: tree-row
tokens.usage: A row in the file tree.

tokens.name: rail-width
tokens.usage: The session rail.

tokens.name: drawer-width
tokens.usage: The right drawer.

tokens.name: chat-width
tokens.usage: The chat column's maximum width.

tokens.name: inset-rail
tokens.usage: How far a separator stops short of the rail's edges.

tokens.name: inset-main
tokens.usage: How far a separator stops short of the main view's edges.

tokens.name: inset-drawer
tokens.usage: How far a separator stops short of the drawer's edges.

tokens.name: inset-row
tokens.usage: Where a session row's separator starts, so it lines up with the title, not the glyph.

tokens.name: inset-section
tokens.usage: A short rule between sections of one panel.
